rule_def.message: Amazon titles are capped at 200 characters; this one is {value} characters.
rule_def.suggestion: Rewrite the title to 200 characters or fewer. Keep the brand name first, keep the size and colour, and drop repeated keywords.

rule_def.message: Flipkart titles are capped at 150 characters; this one is {value} characters.
rule_def.suggestion: Shorten to 150 characters or fewer, leading with brand and product type.

rule_def.message: '{term}' is a prohibited claim or promotional phrase on Amazon.
rule_def.suggestion: Remove '{term}' and describe a verifiable product attribute instead. Do not substitute a synonym for the same claim.

rule_def.message: Kurta sets require a 'fabric' attribute, one of: {allowed_values}.
rule_def.suggestion: Set attributes.fabric from the product data. If the source does not state the fabric, leave it unset and flag the row rather than guessing.
